about_the_game:
Exodus of Descent is a dynamic third person online dungeon-looter RPG inspired by games such as Runescape, Dark and Darker, and Monster Hunter. Party up with your friends to run through intense PvE dungeons. Each dungeon contains challenging enemies, bosses, secrets to find, puzzles needed to solve, and 150+ lootable items including weapons, armor pieces, amulets, and crafting materials. Risk it all to Escape your Descent. Will you make it out alive?

Demo

Create your character and tackle the first low level dungeon within the Exodus of Descent Steam demo! Collect loot up to Epic rarity, get your character to level 10, and enjoy 2 player online PvE multiplayer co-op! Please note, characters created in the demo will not transfer over to the full game release.

short_description: Descend into an online third person PvE RPG dungeon looter inspired by RuneScape and Dark and Darker. Party up with your friends to solve escape-room type puzzles, collect over 150+ lootable items, level up your character, create unique classes and unlock new abilities. Escape Your Descent!
